body.name: \(\phi_{n,m}^{(4)}\)
body.construction: Partition \(\mathcal X\) into \(J=m^d\) equal cubes of side \(h=m^{-1}\). For \(c\in I\), put \(V_i(c)=Y_i-cA_i\) and average the symmetrization of \(J^3\mathbf 1\{X_1,X_2,X_3,X_4\text{ lie in one cube}\}(A_1-A_2)[V_1(c)-V_2(c)](A_3-A_4)[V_3(c)-V_4(c)]/4\) over distinct quadruples to obtain \(U_{n,m}(c)\). Minimize its quadratic polynomial in \(c\) over \(I\) by checking the two endpoints and the stationary point when its curvature is positive. Reject when this minimum exceeds \(L^4d^{\alpha+\beta}h^{2(\alpha+\beta)}/16+\{20480[L^4d^{\alpha+\beta}h^{2(\alpha+\beta)}/(16n)+J/n^2+J^2/n^3+J^3/n^4]\}^{1/2}\); return non-rejection when \(n<8\). Evaluate the quadratic coefficients from the within-cube counts \(N_{B,a,y}\) and falling factorials, in \(O(n+J)\) arithmetic and \(O(J)\) memory.
